content:
emily: seeing a spike of 502/504 from inference workers to control-plane behind PrivateLink. started ~10:02 UTC. pods in us-west-2a mostly impacted. example: curl to https://controlplane.internal returns TLS handshake timeout.

raj: noted. any recent network PRs?

emily: deploy-bot shows NAT gateway switchover at 09:58 (deploy-bot: NAT migration completed). only subset of pods affected.

oliver: can you paste nslookup/host for controlplane DNS from affected node?

emily: runs 
```
$ nslookup controlplane.internal
Server: 169.254.169.253
Address: 169.254.169.253#53

Name: controlplane.internal
Address: 10.10.5.42
Name: controlplane.internal
Address: 10.10.12.87
```

raj: both IPs are interface endpoint ENIs in different AZs. which one do pods resolve to? TTL?

emily: TTL is 30s. affected pods resolve to 10.10.12.87 (us-west-2a). traceroute shows first hop the endpoint ENI then timeout.

oliver: check SG on endpoint ENI (allow ephemeral ports from pod subnets). run: `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces --network-interface-ids eni-0abcde12345`

emily: snippet from describe:
```
"Groups": [{"GroupId": "sg-0ff1c3","GroupName": "privatelink-endpoint"}],
"Attachment": {"InstanceOwnerId": "amazon"}
```

oliver: ok open the sg inbound? looks like only 443 allowed from VPC CIDR but ephemeral ports are inbound from service side — i remember PrivateLink service uses source ports above 1024 for reply. need rule allow ephemeral high ports from service ENIs.

raj: also check route table for endpoint ENI subnets — during NAT switchover we added a more specific 0.0.0.0/0 blackhole in one RT which may have caused return path to go to NAT instead of to the endpoint. if response SNATs, SGs might drop it.

emily: confirmed: subnet rt for 10.10.12.0/24 had a more specific 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0badcafe with metric that was attached in the change. 

oliver: plan: 1) revert that route change for endpoint subnets 2) add SG rule to allow ephemeral response ports from the controlplane service SG 3) increase Private DNS TTL to 300 to reduce flip-flop while we stabilize. 

raj: +1. Also disable source/dest check on the endpoint ENIs? Actually interface endpoints are AWS-owned ENIs so can't change that, but confirm no manual source/dest toggles. 

emily: doing step 1 now. 

infra-bot: route-table rtb-0f123 updated: removed 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-0badcafe

emily: tests green for a few pods :tada: but one still failing in 2c.

oliver: check if that node still resolving to the older AZ IP because of TTL. try `dig +short controlplane.internal` and curl with `--resolve` to test AZ IP.

emily: after `dig` it now prefers 10.10.5.42 and curl succeeded. looks like TTL flip fixed it. 

raj: follow-up: create a config doc to ensure NAT migrations exclude endpoint subnets and add SG runbook for PrivateLink ephemeral ports. I'll create a ticket. :memo:

emily: thanks — will monitor & add to postmortem if anything else shows up. 

deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-2413 "Privatelink endpoint subnet routing & SG runbook" assigned to raj. 

emily: closing thread, will reopen if it recurs. :white_check_mark:
